name: Drift Signal
bio: Drift Signal is a Seattle-based grunge revival band formed in 2018. The core quartet is Marcus Reid (lead vocals/rhythm guitar), Derek Thompson (bass/primary harmonies), Aaron Martinez (drums/upper harmonies), and Sadie Chen (lead guitar). They channel the emotional weight and quiet–loud dynamics of 90s alternative rock while keeping modern studio clarity. Their signature is a three-voice blend over melodic grunge and alternative ballads that can move from intimate, fingerpicked acoustic arrangements to full-stack electric catharsis. Lyrically they live in grief, loss, melancholic nostalgia, spiritual and existential questioning, and the fragile beauty of broken people in ordinary places.
voice: Tri-vocal male grunge band: emotional baritone lead with vulnerable falsetto peaks, smoky low-tenor harmonies, and raspy high baritone/tenor accents, all kept raw and human rather than over-polished.
delivery: raspy shouts and cracks at climaxes (brief, earned)
whispered or near-spoken confessions in bridges and breakdowns
influences: Red Hot Chili Peppers mid-tempo ballads
